metadata.description: Skills for reviewing, writing, and finding research papers, for advisors, students, and peer reviewers. Install any skill on its own; each brings the skills it needs.

plugins.name: polish-paper
plugins.description: Advisor-guided review of a student's paper draft. Checks the argument, sections, paragraphs, figures, and length against an advisor's paper-writing guide, and proposes small revisions with reasons on an editing page, where the author accepts, rejects, or edits each one before it reaches the source. Can also write a mock reviewer report.

plugins.name: review-paper
plugins.description: Peer reviews of others' papers in Hang Yu's reviewing style, on a review page with the evidence under each point and buttons to accept, edit, or reject it. Also proposes edits to a manuscript's text on the editing page when asked.

plugins.name: find-sota-papers
plugins.description: Finds and verifies current research papers under explicit constraints (topic, benchmark, date, citations, well-known institutions, count, layout), with a working link and evidence links for every paper and no paper listed from memory. You choose the settings when you use it directly; polish-paper and review-paper call it in a light, automatic mode for related-work, novelty, baseline, and citation checks.

plugins.name: writing-vocabulary
plugins.description: Hang Yu's vocabulary for writing about robot learning and human-robot interaction: terms with fixed meanings, terms marked by how familiar they are to the author, the vocabulary of field dissertations, and acronyms, with the full 1,100-term technical vocabulary and a checker that sorts a draft's words by familiarity.

plugins.name: writing-style
plugins.description: Hang Yu's writing style: 72 writing patterns with weighted evidence from instructions, hand edits, and 16 review records, entered through a short quick reference, and the committee writing style reference. polish-paper and review-paper use it for the wording of every proposal and review. It uses writing-vocabulary for technical terms when that plugin is installed, and works without it.

plugins.name: html-templates
plugins.description: Two HTML page templates for accept-or-reject review workflows: an editing page whose accepted edits are applied to LaTeX sources after a dry run, and a review page with the evidence under each point of a peer review.
